title: A Realistic View of What Kirk Cousins 2.0 Brings to the Vikings

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: A Realistic View of What Kirk Cousins 2.0 Brings to the Vikings
sources.description: The Minnesota Vikings made the move they had to make after a half-season of underwhelming quarterback performance in trading for Kirk Cousins. He will be the starter as soon as possible, which is likely to be this Sunday against the Packers. His arrival has come with much fanfare as the savior of the Vikings offense […]
